records.claim: Austria's Other Key Workers route is a specific Red-White-Red Card sub-route for third-country nationals taking up key-worker employment. The official migration portal states that the prospective employer must pay at least €3,465 gross per month in 2026, a labour-market test applies, and the applicant must reach at least 55 points under the published qualification, work-experience, age, language and other criteria.
records.methodology: Direct review of the official Other Key Workers sub-route page. Evidence is deliberately scoped to this sub-route and is not used to promote the full Red-White-Red Card family.

records.claim: The Other Key Workers sub-route issues a Red-White-Red Card valid for 24 months when the route requirements are satisfied, including the qualifying employment, remuneration, labour-market test and points requirements described by the Austrian migration authority.
records.methodology: Direct review of the official Other Key Workers route page; no claim is made that this process represents all Red-White-Red Card categories.
